summary: Three hunters' truck slid off the road and became stuck in mud; stranded in the remote Spring Creek area near the Colorado-Utah border; Mesa County SO deputies and SAR ATV team located them safe and transported them back to town.
location: Spring Creek area, Glade Park, Mesa County
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office, Mesa County Search and Rescue ATV team
notes: Reported Tuesday Oct 19, 2021; page incident date Oct 22, 2021 @ 11:09am.
